schemeScope: Combined Higher scheme LC001ALP000EV (named EV, printed in Irish). PDF 19 prints the Triail Chluastuisceana marks: Tuiscint 90 + Cumas Gaeilge 10 = 100, and each section’s tariff (Fógra 1–3 "2 marc × 5", Comhrá 1 "× 6", 2 "× 8", 3 "× 6", Píosa 1 "× 3", 2 "× 4", 3 "× 3"). PDF 20–25 print the answer key: each question restated, then its answers as bullets priced with the unit "m" ("= 2m", "= 1m", "= 0m"). PDF 26–30 print the recording’s script ("Téipscript 2010"); PDF 31–32 are blank. PDF 2 is blank, PDF 3–13 belong to Páipéar 1 and PDF 14–18 to Páipéar 2.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover with the examiner’s box, 2 the Treoracha, 3–8 the questions) and scheme PDF 19–32 read in the text layer and checked against the rendered page; the builder asserts every printed question on its paper page, every section tariff line on PDF 19, and every key restatement in order on PDF 20–25, and lifts each question’s key chunk between one restatement and the next with the key’s own headings and question numbers stripped.

nonPoolDecisions: One card per printed segment: three announcements (Fógra a hAon, a Dó, a Trí), three conversations each in two míreanna (An Chéad Mhír, An Dara Mír), and three news pieces (Píosa a hAon, a Dó, a Trí): 12 cards. Each printed question (45) is its own criterion at its section’s tariff, 2 marks.

Each criterion’s guidance is the key’s chunk for that question (PDF 20–25), word for word: the restated question and its bullets with their prices and bracketed notes. Its permitted marks are 0, the tariff 2 and the single prices its bullets print ("= 1m"), as the 2012 Higher key; no partial is inferred where the key prints none.
Cumas Gaeilge 10 is one award for the whole test (PDF 19); it is stated on every card and never split into a card.
The key prints no general grade table and no note for the listening test.
sourceFindings: The aural paper is its own component before 2012 (LC001ALPA00IV, 100 marc, Dé Luain 14 Meitheamh 4.30–5.10); its existing Atlas entries are the section numbers 1, 2 and 3 (Cuid A, B, C). The segment cards add L-A-F1 … L-C-P3 beside them.
The scheme’s PDF 19 draws every "×" with SymbolMT U+F0B4 (9 spans), read as "×"; the key’s bullets on PDF 20–25 are SymbolMT U+F0B7 (131), read as "•"; the aural paper prints no symbol-font span.
Unlike 2011, the 2010 scheme prints an answer key for every listening question, so no listening criterion is tariff-only.

Misprints kept as printed: the paper’s Fógra a Trí 3(b) "le airgead" (key "le hairgead"); the paper’s Fógra a Trí 2(a) "tíre ?" with a space; the key’s Comhrá a Trí An Dara Mír 1 "téacleabhair" (paper "téacsleabhair") and 2 "Ghaeilge –Bhéarla" (paper "Ghaeilge-Bhéarla"); the key’s Fógra a Dó 1 bullet "Searmanas = 2m cuimhneacháin = 2m (in ómós do C. Maude)", two prices on one bullet.

Odd key shapes kept as printed: "Idirbhliain = 2m / Eatramhach = 2m" (two alternatives on one bullet), "Siopaí = 1m + cáiliú = 1m (de gach saghas)" (an answer and its qualifier priced 1 + 1), "€50 = 1m" and "Cártaí leis féin = 0m" (refused or partial answers).
